purpose: Define and qualify a deterministic conservation-preserving integer safeguard between an adaptive physical-head allocation and its exact uniform control without inheriting the Ada-KV paper/code coefficient ambiguity.

sources.use: motivates a uniform-allocation safeguard but leaves integerization unresolved
pins the code-like independently rounded safeguard that fails the registered six-slot witness
predecessor qualification and frozen safeguard counterexample

naming.uniform_fraction: lambda in [0,1], explicitly the fraction moved toward uniform allocation
naming.forbidden_alias: alpha is not used because the paper and audited code attach the reported 0.2 coefficient to opposite mixture terms

input_contract.adaptive_budgets: H non-negative integer physical-head budgets a_h, each at most T, with total B
input_contract.token_capacity: positive integer T shared across physical heads
input_contract.uniform_fraction: an exact rational lambda in [0,1], supplied as an integer, Fraction, or canonical numerator/denominator string; binary floating-point inputs are rejected
input_contract.total_budget: B=sum_h a_h is preserved exactly and may range from zero through H*T
input_contract.scope: integer apportionment only; it does not acquire salience, change selected-token identity within a head, or establish any quality benefit

target.uniform_real_budget: u=B/H for every head; it is not prematurely rounded
properties: lambda=1 targets exact uniform real budgets

integerization.method: Hamilton largest remainder over exact rational targets
steps: give one slot to the remaining heads in descending fractional remainder order
break equal remainders by ascending physical-head index
guarantees_to_test: integer budgets sum exactly to B
each integer budget is floor(x_h) or ceil(x_h)
the result minimizes exact L1 and squared L2 deviation from x over every feasible integer allocation
ties among joint L1/L2 minimizers prefer the lexicographically largest budget tuple, equivalent to lower-index remainder priority
every head receives at least floor(lambda*B/H) slots
lambda=1 returns the existing quotient/remainder uniform control

negative_control.purpose: preserve the observed conservation failure rather than silently repair or relabel upstream behavior

qualification_cases.adaptive_allocations: every vector in [0,T]^H, spanning every total B
qualification_cases.oracle: for every case enumerate all feasible integer H-vectors in [0,T]^H with the same total B and compare exact rational L1, squared L2, and deterministic tie order
required_special_cases: invalid booleans, floats, negative budgets, capacities below a head budget, malformed fractions, and lambda outside [0,1] rejected

required_outputs: capacity, floor/ceiling, lower-floor, endpoint, exact L1, exact squared-L2, and deterministic-tie pass flags

decision.failure: retain the result and keep safeguard use blocked
decision.success: qualify only a conservation-safe integer apportionment control for later paired empirical evaluation
